problem: I need you to outline the key regulatory frameworks we must comply with
goals: I need you to outline the key regulatory frameworks we must comply with
recommend tools for consent management and data mapping
and identify the biggest compliance gaps a startup at our stage typically has.
context_facts: We're a 50-person startup that just raised Series B and we need to set up a proper data privacy compliance program.
We operate in the US and EU, process personal data from about 100K users, and our engineering team handles most compliance manually right now.
We don't have a dedicated legal team yet — just outside counsel.
deliverables: Consent management and data mapping tools
meta_requirements: Please be specific to our situation rather than giving textbook definitions of GDPR and CCPA.
